## ⚠️ STOP: DO NOT FILE A PUBLIC ISSUE FOR SECURITY VULNERABILITIES

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in Stellar Postage, **please DO NOT create a public issue**.

Instead, please send your report privately to:

📧 **`devogazi@gmail.com`**

### What to Include:

- Clear description of the vulnerability.
- Proof of Concept (PoC) or reproducible steps.
- Assessment of potential impact.

Please see our **[Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md)** for more details regarding our coordinated disclosure timeline and safe harbor commitment.
